title: Keep the names of products in stock
prompt: Write `stockedNames(products: Product[]): string[]`. Return the `name` of every product where `inStock` is `true`, in input order. Keep repeated names and empty names.
hints: Which field decides whether a product is kept?
Use `filter` to choose products, then `map` to turn each into its name.
There is one output entry for every product that is kept.

wrongAnswers.misconception: Keeps products that are out of stock.

feedback: Which field decides whether a product is kept?
